_comment: Monster groups put somewhere on purpose, and Ankama's own taken away.
The 38,744 groups in world.db are Ankama's placement and are regenerated with it, so
neither adding to them nor removing from them can be done in that file: the work would
vanish the next time anybody rebuilt the database, without a word.
"members": [ { "monster": 2549, "grade": 0 } ] }
Ids for groups placed by hand start at -2000000 and go down. The measured ones run from
-1000000 to -1038743, so the two bands cannot meet and an id says which kind it is at a
glance.
The level of a member is not written down. It follows from the monster and the grade, the
server works it out, and a second copy of a derived number goes stale the day a grade table
changes.
A group written here is placed even on a map the indoor veto covers. That veto is a rule
about what Ankama scattered on its own, not about what somebody puts here knowingly.
THE KANOJEDO'S PUNCHING BAGS. Six Puch Ingball (494) on 'The Kanojedo' 99090957, one per grade
from level 1 to level 200, and the same six on the tester dojo 146801922. Cells, facings and
grades are measured off the jss of Clases/Hipermago (99090957) and Clases/Ocra (146801922):
every group is one monster, closes with f5 = -1, and the level-200 one travels as grade 6.
They never move and are never replaced: a kanojedo map fights under the training rulebook,
which leaves the group where it was after a win.
'orientation' is which way the group faces, 1 to 7, south-east when absent.
